about_the_game:
In Midas, you'll place buildings using cards, unlock new tools and combos, and carefully combine them into explosive production chains. Each turn is a chance to push your automation further, optimise your layout, and discover new synergies.

Whether you're crafting a compact engine or sprawling across the land, your goal is simple: satisfy the king by making as much gold as possible.

The more advanced your goods, the more gold you'll earn. Process, combine, and upgrade your resources to squeeze every last drop of value from the land around you. Chain your buildings carefully; funnel everything into the Keep and multiply your income with every step.

No two buildings are the same and their effects can ripple across your kingdom in surprising ways. Some produce resources, while others modify their neighbours. To find the strongest strategies, you'll need to combine cards from completely separate production lines. With so many buildings, there's always a new interaction to uncover.

The King demands the biggest castle possible. Deliver gold and build the towers higher and higher,

With each upgrade comes a cost greater than the last. How far will you be able to push your kingdom before you test the King's patience.

Your deck is your toolbox. Each new card unlocks a building or action that changes how you play.

Earn new cards by exploring, placing buildings, and completing recipes. A larger deck will give you more options and more options means more combos and more gold.

The world of Midas is filled with secrets. Each region introduces unique resources, buildings, and challenges. You'll find powerful structures that you could never build yourself. Use them along with everything else the lands have to offer and lead your kingdom to new heights.

Key Features

- Build Production Chains: Turn raw resources into gold by linking buildings together.

- Discover Combos: Mix cards and buildings to unlock powerful synergies.

- Appease the King: Earn enough gold to upgrade the Keep before his patience runs out.

- Unlock Cards: Expand your deck with new buildings and tools that change how you play.

- Explore New Lands: Each region offers unique resources, structures, and surprises to uncover.

Extra Details

King's Patience:

When the King runs out of patience, your Keep turns to gold and stops upgrading. This determines your final score for that run but you can continue playing and building freely.

Deckbuilding:

Midas isn't a standard deckbuilder. Many cards will be added to your deck passively and your chance to draw a card changes based on whether you've played or discarded it. Instead of carefully controlling your deck, Midas rewards stacking cards, using tools to target-draw what you want, and improvising when luck doesn’t go your way.

Break the Game:

As each upgrade requires exponentially more gold, you'll need to come up with creative strategies if you want to push past the next barrier.
